title: Audit: electric-motor magnetics and topology optimization
description: Surface-PM machine (4 poles, 24 slots, nonlinear iron): cogging torque, torque vs current angle, back-EMF and losses with the 2D A_z FEM of pinneapple_simulation.electromagnetics. Torque is computed twice -- Maxwell stress (Arkkio) and virtual work (co-energy differences) -- and the two are printed side by side. Dimensions, materials and loss coefficients are illustrative. Runs in about two minute
